function.name: identify_patient
function.description: Identify a patient by their date of birth. The system automatically uses the caller's phone number.

dob.description: The patient's date of birth (e.g., '03/15/1985' or 'March 15, 1985')

name.description: The patient's full name (only needed if phone lookup fails)
